prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single 2D Spine rear-hair attachment
Input images: Image 1 defines the original character's short silver-white bob and screen-right-facing three-quarter combat orientation; Image 2 reinforces the layered hair shape and cool silver-lavender palette.
Primary request: Draw exactly one standalone rear-hair attachment for the same original fantasy mage. It is the back and underside mass of her short layered silver-white bob viewed from a three-quarter angle while the character faces screen-right. Build a compact rounded crown, layered outward side locks, a softly tapered nape and several separated lower tips that can sway. Include a solid hidden scalp-and-nape overlap area extending about 12 percent inward beneath where the face, front bangs and neck will cover it. The screen-right outer silhouette should leave room for a separate butterfly attachment; do not draw the butterfly itself.
Style/medium: crisp premium 2D anime game attachment; controlled flat cel-painted silver, white and pale-lavender shapes; thin cool-gray contour; restrained interior two-tone strand grouping; matte non-emissive material; hard precise physical silhouette with normal antialiasing only.
Composition/framing: exactly one continuous rear-hair piece, centered and large enough for clean downscaling, with broad unused margin on every side. Show every hair tip and the entire hidden overlap base, uncropped.
Constraints: every highlight and shadow ends at the physical hair contour; paint absolutely nothing outside it. No face, eyes, glasses, eyebrows, ears, skin, neck, torso, clothing, hand, butterfly, ribbon, bow, hairpin, second hair piece, duplicate view, aura, outer glow, bloom, rim light, backlight, luminous outline, soft fringe, haze, fog, smoke, particles, shadow, floor, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logo, signature or watermark. No sprite sheet, atlas page, turnaround, panel grid, inset image or multiple views.
